              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's display name, formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The owner's initials, the first letter of the first and last
                name, upper-cased and dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's sequential membership number, assigned at
                creation as one more than the current number of owners.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 11
              readOnly: true
            registrationDate:
              title: Registration date
              description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
              type: string
              format: date
              example: '2013-01-01'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, assigned at creation and formatted
                as '<UPPERCASE_CITY>-<NNNN>' where NNNN is one more than the number of
                owners already in that city, zero-padded to four digits.
              type: string
              example: 'LONDON-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: The owner's membership tier, assigned at creation. The first
                100 owners ever created are 'FOUNDING' and all later owners are 'STANDARD'.

              title: Namesake count

              type: integer
